mentions.name: YAML workflow automation tool
mentions.description: A workflow automation tool that lets developers write workflows as simple YAML files and deploy them to the cloud or on-premise. Each workflow combines a trigger with a set of actions that can transform data, make API calls, run AI models, or run anything via Docker, with each step relying on the output of the previous step. The framework is declarative, testable, and versioned — like GitHub Actions but for anything (e.g., webhook to Slack, email to support ticket, nightly AWS backup & restore, nightly file mirroring).
